text:
Alex: Heads up — post-launch cleanup for RecentChanges. Quick alignment ask: which bugs must land next sprint vs which go back to roadmap? Need a decision by EOD Friday.
Priya: +1. My rule of thumb: P0/P1 = ship next sprint, P2+ = backlog unless CS escalates. :thinking_face:
Mateo: QA flagged two issues: inline edit NPE (P1) and list sort flake (P2). Inline edit looks small, I can patch it in ~1 day.
Jordan: Saw a cache fallback spike correlating with the deploy — not customer-facing yet but it's noisy. I think mitigation = P1 (config guard + alert tuning).
Sam: Customer success report: three paying customers hit the sort flake (P2) and asked for ETA. They'd accept a short-term workaround.
Lina: There's also a UX tweak for reassignment dropdown that will cut support volume. Low effort, ~2 days design+dev.
Alex: Proposed decision: freeze P0/P1 into the next sprint; P2+ back to backlog unless CS pushes. Also pick up Lina's UX tweak as a quickwin under a "support-reduction" tag. Thoughts?
Priya: Sounds good. Can we confirm owners? Mateo, can you take inline edit? Jordan own the infra mitigation?
Mateo: I can take inline edit and help with the UX tweak handoff. Plan: inline edit fix + unit tests (1 day); UX tweak dev work (1 day once design is final).
Jordan: I'll do the caching guard and alert tuning. Expect 4-6h to roll out and monitor.
Sam: I'll message the customers with ETA and a documented workaround: `Use Sort > "Date (legacy)"` and clear browser cache. Want that doc by EOD.
Alex: Nice. Quick grooming tomorrow 10:30am PT to triage remaining P2s and assign owners. Action items right now: Mateo - inline edit + UX handoff; Jordan - cache guard; Priya - coordinate release window; Sam - customer comms.
Priya: One more: can we keep a canary channel for customers who hit the sort flake? Would help validate fix before wide rollout.
Mateo: Yes — I'll push a `1.1.1-canary` tag and coordinate with Jordan on traffic routing.
Alex: :thumbsup: I'll update the roadmap board and set sprint priorities. If anyone hits a blocker, ping here.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary cluster created for tag `1.1.1-canary` — health: pending.
Alex: Last call — locking these decisions unless someone objects by EOD. Thanks everyone!
